partners.mechanism_chain: SGSH (HGNC:10700) —DISRUPTS→ Heparan sulfate biosynthesis (GO:0000224); Heparan sulfate biosynthesis (GO:0000224) —PRODUCES→ Heparan sulfate (CHEBI:57970); Heparan sulfate (CHEBI:57970) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal abnormalities (HP:0000001); HSPG2 (HGNC:5219) —DISRUPTS→ Heparan sulfate biosynthesis (GO:0000224); HSPG2 (HGNC:5219) —LEADS_TO→ Myotonia (HP:0002411). Loss-of-function mutations in SGSH (MPS3A) and HSPG2 (SJS1) both disrupt the biosynthesis of heparan sulfate, a critical component of the extracellular matrix and cell surface. While SGSH is directly involved in the N-sulfatase activity required for heparan sulfate maturation, HSPG2 encodes perlecan, a major heparan sulfate proteoglycan essential for basement membrane structure and signaling. Dysregulation of heparan sulfate biosynthesis and structure leads to distinct but overlapping cellular defects, manifesting as skeletal abnormalities in MPS3A and myotonia in SJS1, highlighting a shared pathway disruption.
